summary: Show an action held for explicit approval with what was requested, where it waits, and safe focus on decline or cancel.

useWhen.text: Use when a command declares an approval gate or returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED so a person must approve or withdraw the request.

avoidWhen.text: Avoid for routine read commands or reversible edits that do not require an approval gate.

keep.text: Exposes an accessible dialog or status region naming the pending approval request.
Provides an operable Cancel, Decline, or Withdraw control that can be focused and activated from the keyboard.
When presented as a confirmation dialog, initial focus lands on Decline or Cancel rather than Approve.
Name what was requested, who or what must approve it, and any expiration or hold window in plain text.

customize.text: Present as a modal confirmation dialog for synchronous approval or an inline held-request panel when approval is asynchronous.

default.text: Mount an approval request dialog or region showing what is held for approval with an operable Cancel or Decline control.
